title: Neemah
dek: A bark-skinned figure who greets newcomers with a call to work for life, whether by blade, hammer, pen or scroll.

facts.Recorded at: The Gate and road to Pristinia

sources: Gate chronicle · selected arrival and welcome scenes; January 2024–September 2026 posting records
body:
A welcome among the trees

Neemah first appears as a small fey-like woman with bark-like flesh and ageless blue eyes. She calls the Gate a welcoming place for potential heroes of Etz Chaim, while stressing that not every arrival will become one. Her welcome includes work with a hammer or a pen as well as a blade.

Fighting for life

At a later gathering with Coralyn, Joe-Joe, Cerwin and Nex, Neemah gives her name and reframes the newcomers’ purpose: to fight for life, rather than defining their entire future by an enemy. She reassures Coralyn, says her own duty is here, and vanishes among the trees. Her words establish the purpose she offers them; they do not prove what every arrival chose before crossing.
